concepts.definition: consecutive days on which the user completed enough focus; a fact about the calendar, not praise
concepts.not_this: days in the app, login streak, chain of tasks

concepts.definition: one earned freeze covers one missed focus day; not completed focus
a timed session on one task, optionally with apps blocked; the app calls it focus, the timer screen is Moneyfesting
concepts.not_this: meditation, Pomodoro as a product name, work shift (that is the badge metaphor)

concepts.definition: the thing the user focuses on or plans; a focus task is a saved template with a duration and a restricted list; 'ToDo' in keys is internal naming
the named set of apps and categories blocked during a session; the group name 'No Restricted Apps' ships as an unlocalized Swift literal
concepts.not_this: blacklist, restrictions in general, parental controls

concepts.definition: focused time multiplied by the user's own hourly rate; an estimate shown as money, never money received
concepts.not_this: earnings, income, savings, profit, wage paid

concepts.definition: the fixed sentence that follows a time value ('Not money earned.' and its four sibling forms); one target form per source form, reused verbatim on every screen
concepts.not_this: a per-screen paraphrase, a softened or dropped sentence

concepts.definition: the month-end projection of time value from recent focus or screen time; an estimate with a stated formula
the rate the user sets to price their own time; the source says hourly wage or hourly rate
concepts.not_this: salary, earnings per hour, what the app pays

concepts.definition: the daily minutes target drawn as a ring; met or not met, never scored
concepts.not_this: aim, aspiration, life goal (the affirmations use that word differently)

concepts.definition: the compact minutes unit appended to durations ('2h 15m'); one form per locale, spacing decided by the render
concepts.not_this: a spelled-out plural in the tight widget and report lines

concepts.definition: Apple's Screen Time feature and its permission, in Apple's own localization; generic time spent on the screen is a different concept
